description:
[Game reference] NPC missions: where they're given, steps, rewards, time limits, repeat timers. `locations`: each monument with mission givers and its `missions` - `name`, `desc`, ordered `objectives`
(`text`), `rewards` (`item` shortname + `amount`, or `other` for non-item rewards like the Outpost spawn unlock),
`time_limit`, `repeat` (cooldown after success, or "once per wipe"), `requires` (missions to finish first).
Without `monument`, also `tutorial` (tutorial-island missions) and `unplaced` (in the files, not offered on standard
maps). Use monument=<slug> for one place. Link https://rust.wiki/missions.

monument.description: Only missions given at this monument (slug).
